-- in --
package main

templ test(x bool, items []string) {
	<div><span>a</span>if x {
		<b>y</b>
	}</div>
	<p>
		some text
		for _, i := range items {
			{ i }
		}
	</p>
}
-- out --
package main

templ test(x bool, items []string) {
	<div>
		<span>a</span>if x {
			<b>y</b>
		}
	</div>
	<p>
		some text
		for _, i := range items {
			{ i }
		}
	</p>
}
